entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category I and II  
The reduced rate only applies to 
- draught horses, heavy and medium weight in 0101 2100, 0101 2990
- deers in 0106 1900
- domestic pigeons in 0106 3910
- animal blood whether or not dried in 0511 9985

entries.category_description: Supply of goods and services of a kind normally intended for use in agricultural production but excluding capital goods such as machinery or buildings
entries.comment:
Royal Decree n° 20, Table A, category XII:
- 8° fertilizers: the reduced rate only applies for: containing more than 0.01% iron by weight in 2835 2500; fertilizers in 31
- 9° animal products used for reproduction in 0511 1000, 0511 9190, 0511 9985

entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
Royal Decree N° 20, Table A, category XII, the reduced rate only applies to food for animals and goods not offered for sale as food for dogs, cats, caged birds such as parrots and songbirds, for aquarium fish, for hamsters, guinea pigs and other small pets.
The reduced rate applies to agricultural salt - Royal Decree of 10 Sept 1987 in 2501 0099
(The Royal Decree of 8 Feb 1999 for substances intended for animal food)

entries.category_description: Foodstuffs (including beverages but excluding alcoholic beverages) for human and animal consumption; live animals, seeds, plants and ingredients normally intended for use in the preparation of foodstuffs; products normally used to supplement foodstuffs or as a substitute for foodstuffs
entries.comment:
Food for human consumption, excluding food supplied for catering, is taxed at 0% (exempt with credit).  

The above exemption does not apply to items classified under the following subheadings in the First Schedule of the Import Duties Act:

(1) 0101.10.10.00; 0106.11.00.00; 0106.12.00.00; 0106.19.90.00; 0106.20.00.00; 0106.31.00.00; 0106.32.00.00; 0106.39.90.00; 0106.90.00.00

(2) 0206.10.10.00; 0206.29.10.00; 0206.80.10.00; 0206.90.10.00

(3) 0301.10.10.00; 0301.10.90.00
